description: Structured examples of production guides for tailors.

examples.fabric_requirements: 4 yards main lace, 3 yards satin lining, 1 yard skin illusion net, 1 pack rigilene boning, bra cups.
examples.cutting_instructions: Draft corset bodice pattern. Cut front and back panels from lace and lining. Interface all bodice pieces. Cut mermaid skirt panels.
examples.sewing_sequence: 1. Interface bodice. 2. Sew corset channels and insert boning. 3. Attach cups. 4. Sew skirt panels. 5. Join bodice to skirt. 6. Insert zipper.
examples.fitting_process: 1st fitting: Check bodice fit and corset tightness. 2nd fitting: Check skirt drape and hem length.

examples.cutting_instructions: Cut top front and back panels, sleeves. Cut trouser front and back legs, waistband.
examples.sewing_sequence: 1. Prepare front placket/design. 2. Join shoulders and sleeves. 3. Sew side seams. 4. Trousers: join legs, insert zipper, attach waistband.
examples.fitting_process: 1st fitting: Check trouser waist and length. Check top chest fit and sleeve length.
